title: Rental Waiver Share by Storage Unit Size — Bluegate Moving Truck Rental
content:
On a Bluegate Moving Truck Rental free move-in contract, the waiver unit-size share depends on the size of the claimed storage unit — the storage unit whose claim the truck contract carries as its linked storage unit, as its size stands on the Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement:

| Size of the claimed storage unit | Share of the waiver amount |
|---|---|
| 4x5 or 5x5 | **0.6** |
| 5x10 or 5x15 | **0.8** |
| Any larger unit | Whole |

Illustration (hypothetical): on a waiver amount of 29.95, a claimed 5x5 unit gives 17.97 and a claimed 5x15 unit gives 23.96; a claimed 10x10 unit leaves the 29.95 whole.
